title: Grateful Dead Live at Greensboro Coliseum on 1980-05-01
lineage: FOB (Nakamichi 700)> Master Cassette (Sony TC-D5); A>D: Master Cassette (Tascam 112mkIII)>Sony R500 @44.1>; D>CD: DAT> MASTER CDR on HHB CDR 850> Duped to CD(1) on Tascam CD-D4000MKII; CD>SHN: EAC (see info)> Soundforge> CD WAV> SHNv3

ai_review.summary: Good audience recording captures a standout Estimated > Uncle John’s transition, high‑energy post‑Space jams and strong Jerry guitar work.
ai_review.review: The show is praised for its unique moments – especially the Estimated Prophet → Uncle John's Band segue, the soaring post‑Space jam, and Jerry Garcia’s inspired licks (despite a humorous vocal flub on Promised Land). The audience‑recorded tape isn’t pristine but clears up after the opening and delivers an enjoyable listening experience.

ai_rating.rationale: Multiple 4‑5 star reviews highlight exceptional musical moments while noting only modest recording clarity issues; strong consensus yields a high confidence rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Early portion a bit muffled, but sound clears up; overall decent audience mix with occasional minor noise.

show_quality.setlist_flow: First set opens standardly but gains momentum at Big River; second set builds after Space into high‑energy jams, highlighted by the Estimated → Uncle John transition.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Garcia delivers memorable licks throughout and a funny vocal flub on Promised Land.
